record.bible_text: A <FI>good<Fi> name<WH08034> <FI>is<Fi> rather to be chosen<WH0977><WTH8737> than great<WH07227> riches<WH06239>, <FI>and<Fi> loving<WH02896> favour<WH02580> rather than silver<WH03701> and gold<WH02091>. <RF>loving...: or, favour is better than, etc<Rf><CM>

He that hath a bountiful<WH02896> eye<WH05869> shall be blessed<WH01288><WTH8792>; for he giveth<WH05414><WTH8804> of his bread<WH03899> to the poor<WH01800>. <RF>He that...: Heb. Good of eye<Rf><CM>

He that loveth<WH0157><WTH8802> pureness<WH02890><WTH8675><WH02889> of heart<WH03820>, <FI>for<Fi> the grace<WH02580> of his lips<WH08193> the king<WH04428> <FI>shall be<Fi> his friend<WH07453>. <RF>for...: or, and hath grace in his lips<Rf><CM>

The slothful<WH06102> <FI>man<Fi> saith<WH0559><WTH8804>, <FI>There is<Fi> a lion<WH0738> without<WH02351>, I shall be slain<WH07523><WTH8735> in<WH08432> the streets<WH07339>.<CM>

Foolishness<WH0200> <FI>is<Fi> bound<WH07194><WTH8803> in the heart<WH03820> of a child<WH05288>; <FI>but<Fi> the rod<WH07626> of correction<WH04148> shall drive it far<WH07368><WTH8686> from him.<CM>

He that oppresseth<WH06231><WTH8802> the poor<WH01800> to increase<WH07235><WTH8687> his <FI>riches, and<Fi> he that giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> to the rich<WH06223>, <FI>shall<Fi> surely <FI>come<Fi> to want<WH04270>.<CM>
Bow down<WH05186><WTH8685> thine ear<WH0241>, and hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the words<WH01697> of the wise<WH02450>, and apply<WH07896><WTH8799> thine heart<WH03820> unto my knowledge<WH01847>.

For <FI>it is<Fi> a pleasant thing<WH05273> if thou keep<WH08104><WTH8799> them within<WH0990> thee; they shall withal<WH03162> be fitted<WH03559><WTH8735> in thy lips<WH08193>. <RF>within...: Heb. in thy belly<Rf>
That thy trust<WH04009> may be in the LORD<WH03068>, I have made known<WH03045><WTH8689> to thee this day<WH03117>, even to thee. <RF>even...: or, trust thou also<Rf>

Make no friendship<WH07462><WTH8691> with an angry<WH0639> man<WH01167>; and with a furious<WH02534> man<WH0376> thou shalt not go<WH0935><WTH8799>:
Lest thou learn<WH0502><WTH8799> his ways<WH0734>, and get<WH03947><WTH8804> a snare<WH04170> to thy soul<WH05315>.<CM>

Remove<WH05253><WTH8686> not the ancient<WH05769> landmark<WH01366>, which thy fathers<WH01> have set<WH06213><WTH8804>. <RF>landmark: or, bound<Rf><CM>
